snippet.title: Ed, Edd n Eddy's Candy Machine Deluxe Flash Game
snippet.description:
Ed, Edd n Eddy's Candy Machine Deluxe was one of the Flash Games available on Cartoon Networks website.  It was actually a part of some of the earliest games they ever made on their site.  Tons of other Ed, Edd n Eddy flash games came out after.  Skating, side scrolling, etc.  It was a massively popular cartoon at the time and the games brought many to their old site.
